				create_country_leader = { name = "Constantine II" picture = "gfx/leaders/GRE/1970/COLDWAR_GRE_1970_constantine_ii.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Monarchist }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_leader_party = ruling_party }
	}
}

COLDWAR_GRE_1970_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = GRE
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_GRE_1970_retire_modern_roster = yes
		COLDWAR_GRE_1970_refresh_roster = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_assets_d94ce1a9718c } NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_leader_party = ruling_party } } }
			}
			COLDWAR_GRE_1970_set_leader = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_assets_d94ce1a9718c
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_GRE_1970_daily_tick = {
	COLDWAR_GRE_1970_initialize = yes
}
